scope: Commands, events, and reactors only. Read models are a later pass.
principles: Commands begin with the action the person or business process asks the system to take.
Events name a completed fact in past tense.
Reactor names state the business outcome that justifies the reaction; Reactor is the system role suffix.

Formal compliance terms remain when they are part of the business vocabulary. Mechanism terms such as materialize, fence, neutral mutation, bootstrap, fan out, cleanup, effect, chunk, and execution claim do not name the target business action or fact.
Business event names omit implementation version suffixes; the selected source type, discriminator, and discriminator version remain visible as compatibility evidence.
Target names do not change the selected source name, persisted event discriminator, discriminator version, or command identity. Those remain compatibility evidence for implementation planning.

commandPatterns.reason: The command authorizes the named business action; the extra Use suffix describes the coordination mechanism.
The command ends the exact authorization after its business action or cancellation.

eventPatterns.reason: Authorization is already the completed fact; Use adds no stakeholder meaning.
The exact authorization ended; the recorded outcome still distinguishes use, cancellation, or a late fence.

AccessReviewCompletionReactor.businessReason: Complete the campaign only after each selected item has completed or been canceled and its exact authorization has ended.

AuditorRequestResolutionReactor.businessReason: Resolve an auditor request only after admitted response work is preserved and later edits are fenced.

ControlOccurrenceFindingReactor.businessReason: Raise a finding from a control occurrence that did not meet its required result.

EmailReservationReactor.businessReason: Reserve the normalized email address so two tenant identities cannot claim the same address.

EngagementAcceptanceReactor.businessReason: Accept or reject an engagement and staff assignment using the exact service history and required independence decisions.

EngagementPersonalDecisionReactor.businessReason: Record each person's independence decision against the exact engagement revision and service history.

ProviderChangeAcceptedReactor.businessReason: Keep provider names unique through accepted provider changes and retirement.

ReadinessDecisionReactor.businessReason: Record the exact readiness and Type I decisions for the selected program and gap plan.

RiskActionCompletionReviewReactor.businessReason: Keep the evidence cited for a completed risk action unchanged while an independent reviewer decides whether the action worked.

RiskMethodReassessmentReactor.businessReason: Request reassessment when the accepted risk method changes and existing assessments need review.

SystemDescriptionDecisionReactor.businessReason: Require an approved system description or a recorded no-change decision before closing the impact review for a significant change or incident.
